method: LK forward/back checked contours; RANSAC partial affine; fixed caption excluded; post-entry6 to pre-departure7 frames. This measures net held-art transform, not physical camera ownership or original drawing cadence.
limits: Sparse paper/vignette may leave too few corners
Face/hair/hand edits and dissolves break rigid correspondence
A transformed single artwork layer is indistinguishable from camera motion in a mixed export
Caption remains fixed and is intentionally excluded
Partial affine assumes uniform scale+translation+rotation; perspective, masks and blur need direct frame inspection
